heroHeadline: Day 733: Sheinbaum Questions U.S.-Linked Police Academy in Querétaro
heroSubtitle: On October 5, 2026, Sheinbaum said the federal government was not informed of a binational police training academy in Querétaro and that foreign training requires Foreign Ministry approval.
